scope.constraints: Read-only, unprivileged, 32 MiB total source, <=4096 entries, 5 s source bound; no CPU affinity/governor writes
authority: G4-07 Source Authorization and Bounds Rev0.1 SRC-07 row
G4-02/06 Source-Evidence Map Rev0.1 SRC-07 row
G5-03 approved passive_worker.py source_path enumeration contract
G5-04 CP-01 D-02/D-03/D-04 canonical schema and attribution decisions
Requirements Rev1.6, FR-121 raw-source pointer restrictions

independent_expectation_basis: This specification precedes SRC-07 parser implementation. Exact path authority and relative-order rules are derived from accepted G5-03 worker, not from results of the parser under test.

path_contract.order: First root attributes in sorted(root_cpuset) sequence; then cpu directory names in Python sorted() lexical order; inside each cpu directory, per_cpu_attributes in exact tuple order shown, skipping attributes not preserved due to optional unavailability or error. A receipt captures only successful source_paths in same index order as item0001..itemNNNN.
path_contract.evidence: For any semantic datum, source_path field comes solely from matching receipt and artifact slot; raw original bytes are independently SHA-256 verified; no guessed path, no host path re-open, no cross-run evidence.
path_contract.restriction: Path checks must prohibit .., duplicate paths, unsupported/unregistered attribute, extra suffix, unexpected root and unbounded path text. Ordering not numeric CPU order. Ambiguity fails closed.

approved_level_semantics: Permitted bounded interpretation of exact sysfs scalar forms: kernel CPU-list range syntax for global online/possible/present and topology sibling lists (no range expansion); signed decimal package/core ID (no assumed topology when missing); per-CPU online 0/1; cpufreq attribute decimal kHz (no MHz inference). Every acquired value retained as original observation. Malformed scalar remains preserved as fallback with an actually invoked parser failure; unavailable optional attribute is not fabricated.

cases.input: global online + cpu0 topology/core_id + cpu0 cpufreq/scaling_cur_freq sealed in valid worker-relative order
cases.expected: 3 raw observations and 3 typed values with distinct canonical datum paths and exact per-item evidence refs; manifest validates

cases.input: cpu2 and cpu10 both present, capture order cpu10 before cpu2
cases.expected: Valid lexical order accepted; each value attributed to its own original path; never numerically resort

cases.input: missing optional cpu0/online and cpufreq paths, recorded in unavailable_fields only
cases.expected: Do not create observations for missing files; preserve limitation trace; valid captured items stay linked

cases.input: receipt path count does not equal successful sealed artifact count
receipt source_paths swapped, duplicated or CPU attribute order inconsistent with G5-03 worker
cases.expected: Reject even if all values are valid bytes

cases.input: path traversal, wrong tree, cpu name not matched, secret/unsupported attribute
cases.expected: Reject; no filesystem probe; originals remain unchanged

cases.input: item ordinal tampering or cross-run receipt/artifact mismatch
cases.expected: Reject and do not publish canonical manifest

cases.input: invalid integer, out-of-order/overlap CPU ranges, boolean not 0/1, invalid UTF-8 or multiline
cases.expected: Attributed parser error, retained fallback original; never invent values

cases.input: zero CPU entries or root-only captured sources
cases.expected: Do not synthesize CPUs from host; interpret only actually preserved root records

cases.input: source-path identification but missing optional acquisition path
cases.expected: No speculative read or implied existence; unavailable field stays a limitation

review.performed_by: Separate contract-only reasoning step of the implementing AI; does not constitute an independent human or second-agent reviewer
review.stop_rule: Material ambiguity in field mapping, approved status or external behavior requires owner decision; do not silently broaden user-facing contract

claim_limit: Test specification is not executed verification, CP-03 completion, Bodhi host evidence or gate acceptance
